sloka: आघूर्णित तरन्ग ओघः सम्ब्भ्रान्त उरग राक्षसः ।उद्वर्तित महाग्राहः सम्वृत्तः सलिल आशयः ॥६-२१-३२॥।।
transliteration: āghūrṇita taranga oghaḥ sambbhrānta uraga rākṣasaḥ ।udvartita mahāgrāhaḥ samvṛttaḥ salila āśayaḥ ॥6-21-32॥।।

translations.english: The waves rose up tossing and whirling about. The agitated Nagas and Rakshasas were thrown up by a highly disturbed ocean that produced a great sound.
